ambiguities_or_notes: ералаш is rendered as the named card game ‘Yeralash’; the stake is 25 silver kopeks.
The syntactically/logically awkward sentence beginning ‘With people who speak superficially about money matters...’ is preserved without conjectural negation.
The deleted fragment хлопе is not safely recoverable and is transliterated as ‘khlope...’ rather than guessed.
